method: Test every hinted glyph at all fitted sizes/phases against its outline bounds. Allow 2 px plus PPEM/16. Programs exceeding this budget, or whose fitting modes lose resolvable source details, can be bypassed only after direct rendering passes bounds, visibility and detail checks across the entire range. Detail reference: uncompensated original-source resize at the same new design axes and dimensions. No character-name selection rules.
